query_plan.query: Who won the most world cup matches in the last 50 years and how many?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate the matches and count the number of wins for each individual team id, return the team id and the number of wins
steps.query: Return all matches of the last 50 years and their winner

dependencies.dependency: Team id and team name and number of wins for the team with most matches won in the last 50 years

steps.merge_task: Return team name and number of wins for the team with most matches won in the last 50 years
steps.query: Return the team name for the team id with the most wins

extra.sql_query: SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM teams t INNER JOIN matches m ON t.team = m.winner WHERE m.date >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-50 years') GROUP BY t.team ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1;

s1.sql_query: SELECT matches.match, matches.winner, matches.name FROM matches WHERE matches.date >= '1976-09-24T00:00:00Z'

s2.sql_query: SELECT teams.team, teams.name FROM teams WHERE teams.team = 83459
